email.body:
Hi {{ contact.first_name }},

Your titles for {{ custom_values.anthology_name }} are ready.

You can view the PDF here:
{{contact.anthology_titles_pdf_url}}

And you can edit your Google Doc here:
{{contact.anthology_titles_doc_url}}

The PDF is yours to view. The Google Doc is the one you edit, and it is the version we use.

Your chosen title and subtitle will be the title of your book, so please take a look and make your selection here:
https://link.msgsndr.com/widget/form/UgiiSoZsA4vyqOVfO5fi?anthology_id={{ contact.anthology_id }}&stage=s3_gate

Thank you for being part of {{ custom_values.anthology_name }}.

Warmly,
The Editors
